definitions.gloss: bothersome; tiresome; annoying; what a hassle
definitions.explanation: Describes something that requires more effort or trouble than one wants to deal with. Stronger and more colloquial than 面倒.

examples.japanese: ⟦{掃除|そうじ}→掃除：02889_souji⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{面倒臭|めんどうくさ}い。
{面倒臭|めんどうくさ}い⟦{手続|てつづ}き→手続き：05453_tetsuzuki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{多|おお}すぎる。
examples.english: There are way too many tiresome procedures.

examples.japanese: ⟦{毎回|まいかい}→毎回：13202_maikai⟧⟦パスワード→パスワード：05277_pasuwaado⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入力|にゅうりょく}する→入力する：28127_nyuuryokusuru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{面倒臭|めんどうくさ}くて、⟦{指紋|しもん}{認証|にんしょう}→指紋認証：08592_shimonninshou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{変|か}えた→変える：01089_kaeru⟧。
examples.english: Entering my password every time was such a pain, so I switched to fingerprint authentication.

notes:
{面倒臭|めんどうくさ}い is an い-adjective. It is a stronger, more colloquial version of ⟦{面倒|めんどう}→面倒：03809_mendou⟧ (na-adjective meaning "troublesome").

FORMS:
- Adverbial: {面倒臭|めんどうくさ}く
- Casual contraction: めんどくさい (very common in speech)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{面倒|めんどう}→面倒：03809_mendou⟧: troublesome — neutral register, also used as a noun
- ⟦{煩|わずら}わしい→煩わしい：06168_wazurawashii⟧: annoying, vexing — slightly more formal, emphasizes emotional irritation
- ⟦{厄介|やっかい}→厄介：03640_yakkai⟧: troublesome, burdensome — implies the problem is difficult to deal with

The casual shortened form めんどくさい is extremely common in spoken Japanese and is not considered rude among friends, though the full form {面倒臭|めんどうくさ}い is preferred in writing.
